title: Killer Whales Working Together to Hunt Seals on Ice | BBC Earth
summary: BBC Earth shows killer whales working as a pod to create waves that wash seals off ice floes, with the producer explaining how the crew captured behavior once thought a myth.
why: Cited as a striking example of coordinated hunting and intelligence in orcas.

quote.text: Orca gang together to generate large waves in unison to wash off waiting penguins and seals from ice floes
